KOKKOS operator()(TagPairReaxFindBondSpecies) (pair_reaxff_kokkos.cpp:4390-4407): 'if (bo_tmp >= 0.10) { d_tmpid(i,nj) = j; d_tmpbo(i,nj) = bo_tmp; nj++; if (nj > MAXSPECBOND) k_error_flag.view<DeviceType>()() = 1; }'. The views are nmax x MAXSPECBOND (line 4350-4351), so the valid indices are 0..MAXSPECBOND-1; the write happens before the test, and the test is 'nj > MAXSPECBOND' rather than '>=', so index MAXSPECBOND is written before the flag is even set, and after the flag is set the loop keeps writing MAXSPECBOND+1, +2, ... for every remaining bond of that atom. The flag is only inspected after the whole parallel_for completes (FindBondSpecies(), lines 4372-4374 'if (k_error_flag.view_host()()) error->all(FLERR,"Increase MAXSPECBOND in reaxff_defs.h");'). The CPU version src/REAXFF/pair_reaxff.cpp:786-791 has the identical off-by-one but calls error->all() inline, so it overruns by exactly one element and stops. Since the 2D views are contiguous, the KOKKOS overrun silently clobbers the following atoms' rows and runs off the allocation for the last atom. MAXSPECBOND is 24 (src/REAXFF/reaxff_defs.h:54).
